environment.shape: two committed row versions with RECOMMEND INDEX RUN between SET TRANSACTION stale-read setup and the next user SELECT

evidence.user_visible_effect: the next user SELECT reads the current rowset instead of the intended AS OF rowset

lessons.oracle: Use a commit-order timestamp plus a direct AS OF control, then compare the next user rowset; do not rely only on TxnReadTS becoming zero.
lessons.selector: STATE_INGRESS_INTERNAL_SQL survived live wrapper screening: current-session ExecuteInternal helper SQL enters the generic stale-read state machine.
lessons.quality: live current-master wrong-snapshot RED without failpoints; severity remains contract-gated because the product wording says next interactive transaction or query statement.
lessons.negative_boundary: Without pending stale-read state, the same RECOMMEND INDEX RUN wrapper returns and the next SELECT sees both rows.
